notes: The italicized even the word (t022–t024) is added on two distinct grounds: rule 105 for even, whose appositive is carried by no expressed preposition and no substantival article, and rule 103 for the repeated word, λόγον having already been spent at t018. Reading the repetition as a discontinuous second realization under rule 15 remains defensible.
The resumptive it at t029 folds onto ἐδέξασθε as rule 103's named contrast, a pronoun being exactly what rule 7 lists.
Variant SBLGNT.1TH.2.13.v010 (covering s024, s025) is underdetermined between readings both rendered by it is in truth; no textual decision is taken here.
